claim: Executable design knowledge adds practical value beyond matched generation and review compute.
scope: Agent-generated HTML documents and interfaces, including framework-rendered DOM. Python and JavaScript are consumers; HTML is an adapter target.

conditions.knowledge: same entries and content in prose

conditions.selection: same review procedure; no feasibility claims

controls: Same candidate count, token budget, tool budget, rendering and elapsed-cost accounting
Freeze knowledge before held-out brief collection
Randomize presentation order and conceal condition labels
Log artifact, plan, package and prompt hashes; record host/browser versions and failed attempts
secondaryOutcomes: Constraint failure rate and unknown coverage

interpretation.superiority: Use preregistered effect and uncertainty criteria.
interpretation.equivalence: Requires a declared equivalence margin and adequately precise evidence.
interpretation.inconclusive: Failure to establish superiority is not proof of no benefit.
interpretation.portability: Report software conformance separately from quality-effect transfer across model families.

deferred: Automatic Pareto or perceptual diversity selection until validated instruments exist
No-LLM generator ablation until a generator exists
failureDecisions: If adequately powered evidence excludes a practical benefit, narrow the quality claim.
If prose is equivalent within the preregistered margin, retain only justified execution benefits.
If verifiers do not improve measured defects or cost, simplify them.
If epistemic labels do not affect scoped behavior, reconsider mandatory metadata.
If another consumer cannot execute the contract, fix interoperability before claiming portability.
If quality gains do not transfer, limit the generalization claim, not software compatibility.
If descriptor distances fail human validation, do not use them to select candidates.
If unknown coverage dominates a task family, extend the adapter or exclude that family explicitly.
If maintenance exceeds the declared ceiling, reduce the registry.
If repeated candidates improve proxies but harm human/task outcomes, stop using those proxies as objectives.
